original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-dgm-grothendieck-abelian}
Let $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$ be a ringed site.
Let $(\mathcal{A}, \text{d})$ be a differential graded $\mathcal{O}$-algebra.
The category $\textit{Mod}(\mathcal{A}, \text{d})$
is a Grothendieck abelian category.

semantic_review_note: For a sheaf of differential graded O-algebras (A,d) over a ringed site, the category of differential graded A-modules is Grothendieck abelian. The differential compatibility and Grothendieck, not merely abelian, conclusion survive.
